content:
You will be given an argumentation and will be asked about to annotate a specified sentence from it for it's argument components.
Annotate the argumentative parts of specified sentence with their argumentative roles such as pro (proponent), opp (opponent) using xml like tags to indicate start and end of a component.
Note that most of the sentences are argumentative. Annotate as much as you can.

From time immemorial humans have had complementary medicine, and it has not generally been ineffective. A reduction in the amount of chemically produced medication per person is most certainly desirable. This will do little damage to the pharmaceutical industry, and conventional medicine will also hardly suffer. The patient could learn to be more aware of his or her body and to treat it more healthily.
What argument components exists in sentence " The patient could learn to be more aware of his or her body and to treat it more healthily" from the above dispute? Please annotate the constituing words.
<pro>The patient could learn to be more aware of his or her body and to treat it more healthily</pro>
